scope: credential-free local synthetic backup creation and restore admission
controls: continuity entities require non-empty names, positive versions and non-empty locked attribute names
stories and scenes require non-empty titles and positive versions
storyboards require positive versions plus non-empty shot prompts and positive finite durations
timelines require positive versions plus finite non-negative in/start points and positive out points greater than in points
invalid snapshot values fail before atomic backup or restore promotion
limitations: Synthetic local fixtures do not qualify off-host retention, signing, staging restore or production rollback.
S-01 remains in progress pending independent review and separately authorized external reliability evidence.
